title: My Favorite Meals
text:
Lunch is my favorite meal. I eat rice, beans, and chicken. I drink a glass of water with my food.

For breakfast, I like bread and milk. Sometimes I eat an apple. I do not drink coffee because it is too strong.

questions.text: What does the writer drink with lunch?
What does the writer eat for breakfast?
What can you guess about the writer's breakfast?
options: It has more meat than lunch
It is always eaten at school

questions.text: What is the writer's attitude toward lunch?
options: They eat it quickly without thinking

vocabulary.definition: the first meal of the day, eaten in the morning
having a very powerful taste or effect

paragraph_translations: O almoço é minha refeição favorita. Eu como arroz, feijão e frango. Eu bebo um copo de água com a comida.
No café da manhã, eu gosto de pão e leite. Às vezes eu como uma maçã. Eu não bebo café porque ele é muito forte.
